papers.title: Formally Verified Autoresearch for Analyzing the Expressivity of Multi-Head Attention
papers.findings: Original section2 fixed dedicated query, Boolean tokens plus positions; theorem1 linear-fractional normal form, theorem2 denominator-cleared threshold-degree lower bound, theorem5 symmetric sign-change characterization; selected appendixF.3/F.6.
papers.limits: Different domain from our two-token real feature curve; not a direct reduction or novelty clearance. Lean, repository, theorem3 rank-separation proof and autonomous-run claims not audited.

papers.title: Attention-based representations for multi-task computation
papers.findings: Single fixed query with token-lookup keys/values, symmetric Boolean inputs; theorem2 D*H >= threshold degree; lemma7 positive rational form and lemma8 degree bound after clearing denominators.
papers.limits: Does not directly prove our real-exponential zero count; no min/max proof, constructions or experiments audited.

papers.title: Breaking the Softmax Bottleneck: A High-Rank RNN Language Model
papers.findings: Language-model output log-probability matrix modulo row shifts, proposition1/rank bottleneck, nonlinear MoS rank lifting and appendixA proofs.
papers.limits: Not relation attention or a quantum circuit theorem. Empirical tables and natural-language high-rank hypothesis not revalidated; no first nonlinear-rank-lifting claim for this project.

papers.title: Sigsoftmax: Reanalysis of the Softmax Bottleneck
papers.findings: Selected sections3.1-3.3: log-softmax span theorem2, nonlinear positive score criterion, sigsoftmax definition11, theorem3 and appendixA example; theorem4 exact-inclusion proof inspected separately.
papers.limits: Selected sections, not full experiment/appendix audit. Finite-parameter exact inclusion in theorem4 is not adopted: the displayed argument uses an infinite shift/limit. Separate strict-concavity counterexample is in the project note; theorem3 is not discarded.
